loadOlderSetlistsFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when "Load more" fails to fetch older setlists

loadSetlistsFailed.where: Setlists page: error message when the setlist list cannot load

deleteOwnOnly.where: Setlists page: toast when someone tries to delete another person's setlist

setlistDeleted.where: Setlists page: toast after a setlist is deleted

deleteSetlistFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when deleting a setlist fails

setlistDuplicated.where: Setlists page: toast after a setlist is duplicated

duplicateSetlistFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when duplicating a setlist fails

cloningNextWeek.where: Setlists page: loading toast while copying a setlist to next week

clonedNextWeek.where: Setlists page: toast after a setlist is copied to next week

cloneSetlistFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when copying a setlist to next week fails

savingTemplate.where: Setlists page: loading toast while saving a setlist as a template

templateSaved.where: Setlists page: toast after a setlist is saved as a template

saveTemplateFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when saving a template fails

savingDefault.where: Setlists page (admins): loading toast while setting a setlist as the default for a service type

savedAsDefault.where: Setlists page (admins): toast after setting the default setlist for a service type
savedAsDefault.context: {serviceType} is a service type label such as "Shabbat Morning"

saveAsDefaultFailed.where: Setlists page (admins): toast when setting the default fails

transferSucceeded.where: Setlists page: toast after transferring a setlist to another owner

transferFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when transferring a setlist fails

buildingFromTemplate.where: Setlists page / calendar / new-setlist wizard: loading toast while a setlist is built from a template

createdFromTemplate.where: Setlists page / calendar: toast after a setlist is built from a template
createdFromTemplate.context: {setlistName} is the new setlist's name; {matched} of {total} songs were matched to charts (sheet music) in the library

createSetlistFailedWithReason.where: Setlists page / calendar: toast when creating a setlist fails

createTemplateSetlistFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when creating a setlist from a template fails

unknownError.where: Toasts: shown in place of {error} when the failure has no message

newSetlistName.where: Calendar: default NAME given to a blank setlist created from a calendar day (saved as the setlist's name)
newSetlistName.context: {date} is a month and day such as "October 9"

noTracksToDownload.where: Setlists page: toast when downloading an empty setlist for offline use

loadForDownloadFailed.where: Setlists page: toast when a setlist cannot be loaded for offline download

defaultServiceName.where: New-setlist wizard: fallback setlist NAME filled in when a template's name cannot be generated

cloningFrom.where: New-setlist wizard: loading toast while copying an earlier setlist

clonedFrom.where: New-setlist wizard: toast after copying an earlier setlist
clonedFrom.context: {setlistName} is the source setlist's name; {count} is the number of rows (songs and other items) copied

schedulingFailedAfterCreate.where: New-setlist wizard: toast when the setlist was saved but assigning musicians failed

createdFromNamedTemplate.where: New-setlist wizard: toast after a setlist is created from a template
createdFromNamedTemplate.context: {setlistName} is the new setlist's name; {templateName} is the template (service type) name; {matched} of {total} songs were matched to charts (sheet music)

setlistCreated.where: New-setlist wizard: toast after a blank setlist is created

untitledSong.where: Add-to-setlist: fallback song TITLE (saved on the setlist row) when a file name is empty after cleaning

songAlreadyInSetlist.where: Library → Add to setlist: toast when the one song added was already in the setlist

addedSongToSetlist.where: Library → Add to setlist: toast after adding one song
addedSongToSetlist.context: {songName} is the song title; {setlistName} is the setlist's name

addedSongsToSetlist.where: Library → Add to setlist: toast after adding several songs
addedSongsToSetlist.context: {count} is the number of songs (always 2 or more here); {setlistName} is the setlist's name

undo.where: Toast action button that reverses the last change (add to setlist, batch delete)

setlistNotFound.where: Library → Add to setlist: toast when the chosen setlist no longer exists

createdSetlistWithSongs.where: Library → Add to setlist → New setlist: toast after creating a setlist from the selected songs
createdSetlistWithSongs.context: {setlistName} is the new setlist's name; {count} is the number of songs. English keeps "songs" for 1 (current behaviour)

errorCreatingSetlist.where: Library → Add to setlist → New setlist: toast when creating fails without a message

itemsDeleted.where: Setlist editor: toast after deleting the selected rows (with an Undo button)
itemsDeleted.context: {count} is the number of rows (songs, headers, notes)

itemsDuplicated.where: Setlist editor: toast after duplicating the selected rows

alreadyOffline.where: Setlist download: toast when every chart is already saved on the device

offlineSaveNone.where: Setlist download: toast when no file could be saved on the device

offlineSavePartial.where: Setlist download: warning toast when some files failed to save offline

offlineSaved.where: Setlist download: toast after every file was saved on the device
offlineSaved.context: {count} is the number of files. English keeps "files" for 1 (current behaviour)

scanFailed.where: Chart viewer, chord transposer: error when scanning a chart page for chords fails

urgencyInHours.where: Dashboard: badge on an upcoming service starting within 4 hours today
urgencyInHours.context: {count} is the number of hours. English: 1 → "In 1 hour", more → "In 3h" (abbreviated)

urgencyToday.where: Dashboard: badge on a service happening today

urgencyTomorrow.where: Dashboard: badge on a service happening tomorrow

urgencyInDays.where: Dashboard: badge on a service a few days away
urgencyInDays.context: {count} is the number of days (2 or more in practice)
